farm_pond.label: new farm ponds
farm_pond.note: 64 new farm ponds in Goregaon tehsil show no average change in cropping intensity around them that can be told apart from zero: +4.3 points (95% range −2.8 to +11.9). 15 show a likely gain or an early sign of one and 9 a loss, against about 6 each expected by chance. Rabi and summer cropping changed by +0.9 points of the zones' cropland. In 2023-24 and 2024-25, with only the micro-watersheds left as comparison, the 68 ponds with data in those years show +5.0 points (an early sign).
